answer: Each epoch, every service draws its graders randomly from a large stake-weighted pool, like a lottery told as a fable where no one knows the jury until the dune of blocks settles. Reputation and payments attach only to work graded that epoch, so an attacker must buy or fake identities AND land them on the panel by chance; with rotation, cost scales as N/K per try, a timber tax on every attempt, while pre-arranged collusion decays before it ever convenes. Sybils thus earn nothing but fees and slashed stake.
